conditions: Honest representation
Provide accurate skills, experience, portfolio and representative authority. Material misrepresentation may result in rejection or termination under applicable agreements and law.
Qualification

An application is a request, not partnership status. Review may include relevant evidence, clarification, interviews or a proportionate, explained practical evaluation. There is no automatic approval or fixed decision timeline.
Confidentiality

Protect authorized non-public product plans, documents, credentials, customer information, code and discussions. Public information, independently developed work, lawfully obtained information and disclosures required by law are excluded. A separate confidentiality agreement may be required; this acknowledgement is not a comprehensive NDA.
Intellectual property

Existing work remains subject to its existing ownership. Ownership and permitted use of new work must be agreed separately. Before a trial begins, agree scope, existing IP, deliverables, permitted use, ownership or licensing, payment or unpaid status, confidentiality, acceptance criteria and termination. Trials must not conceal substantial unpaid production work.
Data protection

Use personal and business data only for authorized purposes, with least-privilege access, secure storage and transmission. Do not share it or put it into external tools without authorization. Report suspected exposure promptly. Return or delete information when access ends, subject to lawful retention.
Security and access

Do not share credentials, bypass controls, access unrelated projects, export restricted data, install unauthorized software or integrations, or publish private information. Approval alone grants no project, repository, production, financial or administrative access.
Professional conduct

Communicate respectfully, deliver reliably, respond appropriately to feedback and give timely notice of missed commitments. Harassment, discrimination, sabotage, fraud and resource misuse are prohibited.
Compensation and equity

Participation is not automatically paid and grants no equity. Before work starts, separately document compensation, expenses, payment milestones and any equity. Disclose unpaid work before acceptance and assess its legality under the applicable employment and contract rules.
No guaranteed outcomes
Application or acceptance does not guarantee employment, income, investment, funding, equity, assignments, a permanent role, public endorsement, career advancement or commercial success.
Suspension and termination

Applications may be declined and relationships paused or ended with a recorded reason. Where practical, applicants may clarify disputed facts through the program contact. Access can be restricted immediately for security. Records follow the retention policy and applicable agreements. Non-waivable legal rights remain unaffected.
Review required

This plain-language program wording requires review for the actual legal relationship and applicable jurisdiction before opening applications. A checkbox is an acknowledgement, not a claim of a legally sufficient electronic signature everywhere.
privacy: We collect the application fields, evidence links, correspondence, evaluation submissions, notice acknowledgements, decisions and onboarding records to assess, contact and manage collaborators. Do not submit identity numbers, passwords, financial credentials, home addresses or unnecessary sensitive information. Application content is not sent to analytics or used for unrelated marketing.

The authorized UzLeeder administrator reviews applications. Applicants see only their own permitted records. Vercel hosting and private Blob storage process records; hosting may involve international processing. If Telegram notifications are configured, reviewers receive only an application reference, not the application contents. No automatic applicant email delivery is promised.

Declined, withdrawn, closed and ended relationships are deleted after the configured retention period, including their private audit snapshots. Open applications and active partnerships are retained for the review or relationship and must be periodically reviewed. A documented lawful hold may defer deletion; it must have a reason and an expiry date. No indefinite default retention is applied to closed applications.

Contact the configured responsible organization using the contact shown below to request access, correction or deletion where applicable. You can submit corrections, withdraw, or request deletion in your private application area. We may verify that the request is yours and consider applicable retention obligations.

Private access keys, server-side permissions and audit records protect access. Report suspected exposure through the program contact; access may be revoked and incidents assessed, contained and communicated as required. Information may be disclosed when legally required. No particular privacy-law certification or compliance claim is made.
